# About Section

## Problem

Users visiting the website have no information about the school, its mission, or how to use the platform.

## Recommended Solution

Add an informational About page with:

- School information:
  - School name and logo
  - Mission statement and values
  - Brief history
  - Contact information
- Platform information:
  - How to use the activities system
  - Registration guide
  - FAQ section
  - Support contact details
- Links to:
  - School website
  - Social media accounts
  - Privacy policy
  - Terms of service
- School statistics (optional):
  - Total number of activities
  - Total number of students enrolled
  - Number of active committees

## Context

An About page helps new users understand the platform and provides important institutional information. It should be accessible from the main navigation menu and designed to match the overall site aesthetic. This page will give the application a more professional and complete feel.
